effect.name: Natron Link
effect.description: Sends the frames beneath this effect to Natron (through the natron-kdenlive-daemon) and shows the result. If Natron is not available or too slow, the unprocessed frame is shown.
effect.author: natron-kdenlive-link

parameter.name: open_natron
Open in Natron (click to open)
parameter.comment: Every click opens the Natron project above in Natron, creating a pass-through graph first if the file does not exist yet. Needs natron-kdenlive-daemon running.

parameter.name: keep_alpha
Keep original alpha
parameter.comment: Use the colours from Natron and the alpha (transparency) of the original clip.
